title: Cobie Durant suffers accidental teammate step-on in Cowboys game
seoTitle: Cobie Durant steps on teammate in Cowboys game
subtitle: Incident with Markquese Bell occurred just before halftime of the matchup against the Washington Commanders in the football league.
excerpt: Cobie Durant was hit by a teammate's cleat during the Cowboys' duel against the Washington Commanders in the 2026 season.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Dallas Cowboys defensive back Cobie Durant became the center of attention after suffering a painful and unusual incident during the clash against the Washington Commanders, valid for the second week of the 2026 American football league season. At the end of a defensive play, the athlete was accidentally stepped on by the cleats of his own teammate, Markquese Bell. The situation occurred just before halftime of the match held in Dallas and generated moments of physical apprehension for the player.

The accidental collision between teammates

The play happened in the final moments of the first half of the matchup. Cobie Durant was down in the back of the end zone after a pass thrown by rival Jayden Daniels missed receiver Terry McLaurin's hands, resulting in an incomplete pass.

Right after the play was whistled dead, teammate Markquese Bell began celebrating the defensive stop. While backpedaling without watching the space around him, Bell did not see that Durant was still lying on the turf and ended up stepping with his cleat studs directly onto the defender's glute and groin area.

The athlete's physical condition after the blow

The involuntary clash caused immediate pain to Durant, who remained down on the turf right after the contact. Information provided by sources presents divergent versions regarding the athlete's continuation on the field: one report indicates that the defender managed to stay in the game after taking a breath and recomposing himself for a few moments before the halftime break, while another record reports that the athlete had to leave the game due to the physical issue caused by the stomp.

Cobie Durant's journey to arrival in Dallas

Durant is playing his first season as a member of the Dallas Cowboys in 2026. Before joining the Texas team, the defender spent his entire previous career in the league wearing the jersey of the Los Angeles Rams.

During his stint with the Los Angeles team, the defender maintained solid production and also stood out for keeping a positive health record, staying away from injuries for almost the entire period. The Dallas front office trusts that his presence can help stabilize the franchise's defensive system.

The Dallas Cowboys' moment and the game score

The Dallas Cowboys took the field against Washington pressured to give a quick response after suffering a tough defeat in the 2026 season opener. In the first week of the championship, the team lost heavily to the New York Giants 27 to 7.

For this year, Dallas aims to compete for the ultimate title and believes its offense has enough quality to fulfill the season's objectives, requiring only more consistent performance from its defensive group. In the duel where Durant was hit, the Cowboys built a 27-13 lead against the Commanders, who also had trouble losing Jayden Daniels due to an elbow injury.
